title: Payment step 5 — the on-chain evidence: two bridge positions on the payer's side
description: The bridge-in position that carried the full max_amount_in to the Hub, and the separate RESIDUE position that carried the unspent 5.43 CRC back and reached RELEASED.
notes: Gateway: BCCR Central Bank gateway, spoke-crc. Accepts a bearer token as well as the cookie. owner_bank_id is the PAYER commercial bank, not the Central Bank that executed the leg — verified in the delivered relay handler, which passes the payer's bank id through as the position owner. Two things this fixture deliberately does NOT claim. First, the bridge-OUT position is created by the BENEFICIARY's Central Bank on spoke-clp and is not visible from here; asserting on it requires the Chilean gateway. Second, ACTIVE is the last state the delivered code is documented to drive the settlement bridge-in position to (the bridge-in handler blocks until ACTIVE); nothing in the published surface says what it becomes after the Hub token is traded away, so a client must not assert a terminal state on it. Divergences: the platform document declares a bare array where the gateway returns {"positions": [...]}, and its state query-parameter example names PENDING and CLOSED, neither of which exists. mirrored_asset is an address while native_asset is a symbol.
